Select: chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id (from target_dictionary.chembl_id), target_name (from target_dictionary.pref_name). Source: molecule_dictionary, drug_mechanism, target_dictionary, compound_structures. Join: molecule_dictionary to drug_mechanism on molregno; drug_mechanism to target_dictionary on tid; molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Filter: molecule_dictionary.max_phase = 4; drug_mechanism.action_type = 'POSITIVE ALLOSTERIC MODULATOR'. Sort: chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id, target_name.
